The exact current 1-20 title revision guards are checked before snapshot creation and again before the first archive move.
No observed title event or superseded snapshot moves until a complete immutable snapshot exists.
A concurrent title child after snapshot creation remains active and resolves its parent from retained snapshot history.
Partial archive moves preserve a readable graph, expose bounded counts, and can be retried without deleting history.
The product exposes Retain title history with retained, active, and snapshot counts; it does not claim conflict resolution or author authentication.
The strict retain_drive_title_history MCP tool requires exact title guards and returns counts plus bounded current title state without Drive file IDs.
